notes: Every architecture decision record named on a `Decided in:` line of the digest and email service design — the ADRs the digest cadence and delivery design trace back through. This is a two-hop question: the design document is the hop, the ADRs are the answer, and the design document itself is therefore not in the set. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
